description: The Lifecycle Command interface surface for deployment-mode overrides: the --group selector every lifecycle op accepts, the validation of the overrides array on config load, and the resolution of a (task, group) pair to a concrete command with base-map inheritance and token expansion. Feature #65, Unit: Core CLI, Interface: Lifecycle Command.

entities.name: GroupSelection
entities.description: The resolved mode a lifecycle op runs under, derived from the explicit --group flag. Base mode when no --group is given; a named group when --group matches a declared OverrideGroup; a hard error when --group names no declared group. Explicit selection only — no env var or default group. Requirements #149, #151, #152.

fields.name: group
fields.description: The selected group name, or absent for base mode (#151). When present, must match a declared OverrideGroup.group or the op is a hard error (#152).

fields.name: isBase
fields.description: True when no --group was supplied (base mode).

entities.name: ResolvedCommand
entities.description: The concrete command a lifecycle op will run after group resolution and token expansion. For a group op, each task resolves to the group's overlay command when the overlay lists it, else to the base command (inheritance); tokens then expand identically to base tasks. This is the value whose hash is stored in the manifest cache slot. Requirements #149, #150, #153, #154.

fields.name: task
fields.description: The lifecycle-op name being resolved (build/check/contain/publish/run/stop/...). Overrides apply across every lifecycle task, not just build (#153).

fields.name: group
fields.description: The group whose overlay was applied, or absent for base mode.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Whether the command text came from the group overlay or was inherited from the base map. Enum-valued: "group" | "base". Distinguishes an explicit override (#149) from base-map inheritance (#150/#151).

fields.name: template
fields.description: The command template before token expansion, carrying {{env:*}}/{{var:*}}/{{ocean:*}}/{{repo:*}} tokens.

fields.name: command
fields.description: The command after token expansion. Group templates expand through the identical VariableContext (env/var/ocean/repo) as base tasks (#154).

events.name: OverridesValidationError
events.description: Raised on config load when the `overrides` array is malformed: a duplicate group name (#146), an entry with a missing/empty group name (#147), or an overlay task absent from the base map (#148). A validation error rejects the config load itself, distinct from the run-time hard error of an unknown --group (#152).

events.name: UnknownGroupError
events.description: Raised at op time when --group names no declared OverrideGroup for the target repo. A hard error that aborts the op — distinct from load-time validation errors. Requirement #152.

payload.name: known
payload.description: The declared group names, for the error message.

operations.name: ValidateOverrides
operations.description: Parse and validate a repo config's `overrides` array on load, registering each valid group with its partial overlay. Enforces unique non-empty names and overlay-against-base-task-existence. Requirements #145, #146, #147, #148.

operations.name: ResolveGroupCommand
operations.description: Resolve a (task, GroupSelection) pair to a ResolvedCommand: pick the group overlay command when present, else inherit the base command, then expand tokens identically to base tasks. A --group value naming no declared group is a hard error. Requirements #149, #150, #151, #152, #153, #154.
